tagline.zh: DeepSeek Harness 正式版 · 全栈发行

zh.hero_lead: dsh-native 把一台提升过的 DeepSeek Harness 完整打包：官方宿主版本锁定，四个内置插件随库分发，三个社区插件按上游引用，科研版作为内置预设开箱即用。一条命令，复现整条栈。
zh.kpi_note: 口径：本机 web profile 生产环境（2026-08-30 盘点）。
zh.arch_lead: 不改动官方内核：dsh CLI 提供宿主运行时，profile 组合 bundle，插件以 cordis patch 注入界面，preset 以声明式 YAML 组装 agent，技能目录即插即用。每层可独立升级与替换。
zh.arch_l1: 官方 Harness 运行时，版本锁定 0.1.1-rc.2，保证复现一致。
zh.arch_l2: profile/package.json 声明全部依赖与 bundle 组合，安装脚本合并写入本机。
zh.arch_l3: 四个随库分发（源码 + 构建产物可审计），三个按上游来源引用。
zh.arch_l4: 科研 / 建模编程 / 论文：persona、工具面、技能全部声明式，随库可审。
zh.arch_l5: skills/ 目录即插即用，随 preset 携带，不改配置即生效。
zh.stack_lead: 内置插件随库分发（源码与构建产物都在仓库里，可审计、可重建）；社区插件按上游来源引用，装哪一版由清单决定。
zh.presets_lead: 显示名统一英文（宿主不翻译用户预设名），描述与技能包随库分发；科研预设为默认预设。
zh.research_lead: 科研版整建制内置：科研模式预设 + dsh-research-agent 插件 + 学术检索插件。设置面板一枚「科研 · agent 模式」开关接管默认预设与工作台；细节见科研版专站。
zh.cmp_title: 合规：红线高于一切流程
zh.cmp_lead: 发行级红线由仓库测试强制：措辞、图标、密钥卫生全仓扫描；科研预设在运行时再叠加学术诚信约束与最小工具面。
zh.qs_lead: 一条命令复现完整的全栈环境：CLI、七个插件、三个预设全部就位。
zh.qs_2_d: 安装锁版本的 dsh CLI，把四个内置插件与三个社区插件写入 web profile 并注册 bundle，拷贝三个预设；设置文件缺失时写入模板。已装过 dsh 可加 --skip-dsh。
zh.qs_3_d: 浏览器访问本地服务；默认预设已是科研模式，也可在预设下拉里切换。
zh.qs_4_d: Electron 窗口自启动 dsh web，关窗即清理整棵进程树，无孤儿进程。
zh.tree_1: 四个内置插件 + 共享核心库：源码 + 构建产物 + cordis patch
zh.tree_2: 三个预设：科研（默认）/ 建模编程 / 论文，随带技能目录
zh.tree_3: web profile 清单模板：依赖与 bundle 组合
zh.tree_4: 设置模板（已脱敏，不含任何密钥）
zh.tree_5: Electron 桌面包装器：自启动、就绪轮询、进程树清理
zh.tree_6: 跨平台一键安装脚本（Windows / macOS / Linux）
zh.tree_7: 本静态展示站，由 GitHub Pages 托管
zh.footer_note: MIT 许可 · 非 DeepSeek 官方产品；DeepSeek Harness 为深度求索官方开源项目

en.hero_lead: dsh-native packages an upgraded DeepSeek Harness end to end: the official host pinned by version, four bundled plugins shipped in-repo, three community plugins referenced at their upstream sources, and the research edition built in as a default preset. One command reproduces the whole stack.
en.kpi_note: Basis: the production web profile on the maintainer machine (inventory of 2026-08-30).
en.arch_lead: The official kernel stays untouched: the dsh CLI provides the host runtime, the profile composes bundles, plugins inject UI through cordis patches, presets assemble agents from declarative YAML, and skills plug in as plain directories. Every layer upgrades and swaps independently.
en.arch_l1: Official Harness runtime, pinned at 0.1.1-rc.2 for reproducible installs.
en.arch_l2: profile/package.json declares every dependency and the bundle set; the installer merges it into the local profile.
en.arch_l3: Four ship in-repo (source plus build artifacts, auditable), three referenced at their upstream sources.
en.arch_l4: Research / modeling-coding / paper: persona, tool surface, and skills are all declarative and in-repo.
en.arch_l5: skills/ directories plug in as-is, travel with each preset, no config edits needed.
en.stack_lead: Bundled plugins ship in-repo — sources and build artifacts are auditable and rebuildable; community plugins are referenced at their upstream sources, with versions pinned by the manifest.
en.presets_lead: Display names are English by convention (the host does not translate user preset names); descriptions and skill packs ship in-repo. Research is the default preset.
en.research_lead: The research edition ships whole: the Research Mode preset, the dsh-research-agent plugin, and the free academic search plugin. One settings toggle takes over the default preset and the workbench; full detail lives on the research edition site.
en.cmp_title: Compliance: red lines above every workflow
en.cmp_lead: Distribution-level red lines are enforced by repo tests: wording, iconography, and secret hygiene are scanned repo-wide; the research preset layers academic-integrity constraints and a minimal tool surface at runtime.
en.qs_lead: One command reproduces the full stack: CLI, seven plugins, three presets — all in place.
en.qs_2_d: Installs the pinned dsh CLI, writes the four bundled and three community plugins into the web profile with bundle registration, copies all three presets, and seeds a settings template when one is missing. Add --skip-dsh if dsh is already installed.
en.qs_3_d: Open the local service in a browser; the default preset is already Research Mode, and the preset dropdown switches freely.
en.qs_4_d: An Electron window auto-starts dsh web and tears down the whole process tree on close — no orphan processes.
en.tree_1: Four bundled plugins plus the shared core library: sources, build artifacts, cordis patches
en.tree_2: Three presets: research (default) / modeling-coding / paper, each with its skill tree
en.tree_3: web profile manifest template: dependencies and bundle composition
en.tree_5: Electron desktop wrapper: auto-start, readiness polling, process-tree cleanup
en.tree_7: This static showcase, hosted by GitHub Pages
en.footer_note: MIT licensed · Not an official DeepSeek product; DeepSeek Harness is the official open-source project of DeepSeek
